from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-low-seq0/frozen/seen/play/users/u010/system/state/workspace/programs/task-776af229.py')
s='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Full-width and full-height solid lines are tile boundaries.
    hs = [r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != 0 and all(v == row[0] for v in row)]
    ws = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][c] != 0]
    rb = [0] + [r+1 for r in hs]  # starts; adjust to interval boundaries
    rstarts=[0]+[r+1 for r in hs]; rends=hs+[h]
    cstarts=[0]+[c+1 for c in ws]; cends=ws+[w]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    # Locate any non-background exemplar tile, and repeat it throughout all tile positions.
    for ri,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(rstarts,rends)):
      for ci,(x,y) in enumerate(zip(cstarts,cends)):
        if a>=b or x>=y: continue
        # take tile at same position if it contains content; else find first content tile of same dimensions
        src=None
        for aa,bb in zip(rstarts,rends):
          for xx,yy in zip(cstarts,cends):
            if bb-aa==b-a and yy-xx==y-x and any(grid[r][c] != grid[0][0] for r in range(aa,bb) for c in range(xx,yy)):
              src=(aa,xx); break
          if src: break
        if src:
          for dr in range(b-a):
            for dc in range(y-x): out[a+dr][x+dc]=grid[src[0]+dr][src[1]+dc]
    return out
'''
